clips.title: The story
paras: Rogues, warlocks, and their teachers gather in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. The caverns give them room to practice their arts under the Horde's watch.

Below Orgrimmar, the Cleft of Shadow holds rogues of the Shadowswift Brotherhood and warlocks of the Darkfire Enclave. Thrall's Horde honors shamanism and strength of arms, yet its leaders make room for subtler arts. In these caverns, practitioners of poison and fel energy work away from the valley districts and under Orgrimmar's watch.
At the Cleft's lowest point, a passage opens into Ragefire Chasm. Volcanic caves honeycomb the ground beneath Orgrimmar, and their danger draws defenders and sinister cultists to the cavern's edge.
